en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a large clock tower on a hill above a city. The tower has a steep, shingled roof with wooden balconies and large clock faces with Roman numerals on its stone base. Trees and a path frame the foreground, with a person in a hat standing near the edge overlooking the densely built city below. Printed text at the top identifies the location in German.
